name: publicWeb_logWebError
description: Writes one public-web (Next.js) error into HC.ErrorLog, the same table every other component logs to, so tools/log_sweep.sh and the portal's Usage Data see web failures (E16.F3). Deliberately NOT behind ValidateAppAuth — the most valuable errors come from visitors with no session — and reachable only through PublicWebAdminApi behind HC_INTERNAL_SECRET, so only our own server can write here. Every value is trimmed, defaulted and cut to its column width; logging never breaks the page (the CATCH swallows).

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Route or component that failed; blank → 'public-web'. No SQL default.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: One line, what went wrong; blank → 'Unhandled web error'. No SQL default.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Stack or context; cut to 2500 (the column width).

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Member's hasher id when a session was present.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Member's device id (text) when a session was present; NULL stored as ''.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always one row: Success 1 after the insert; Success 0 with ERROR_MESSAGE() when the insert itself failed (swallowed, not logged — there is nowhere left to log it).

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog (id NEWID(), HcVersion, ErrorName, ErrorDescription, ProcName, userId, deviceId, string_1).

codeSmells.detail: @source, @message (line 26-27) have no SQL default. A caller that omits one fails with 'expects parameter' before the SP runs: PublicWebAdminApi's catch logs only a generic exception row and returns 500, and the SP's own graceful checks and error envelope never run.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
